name: echo-loop
description: Echo Loop: a neon synthwave lane runner where your best run races you as an echo.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../EchoLoop-debug.apk && echo 'APK ready: EchoLoop-debug.apk'
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../EchoLoop-release.apk && echo 'APK ready: EchoLoop-release.apk'
scripts.bundle: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab ../EchoLoop-release.aab && echo 'AAB ready: EchoLoop-release.aab'
